name: ml-ml-pipeline
description: Use when the user asks about ML pipelines with Kubeflow Pipelines (kfp v2), TFX, SageMaker Pipelines, Vertex AI Pipelines, ML CI/CD, data and model validation gates or training pipeline orchestration. Produces pipeline components, validation gates and CI/CD integration. Not for MLOps platform setup (use devops-mlops) or experiment logging (use ml-experiment-tracking).
